prompt_used: You are given an image. Write a detailed natural language prompt that could have been used to generate this image. Focus on the most salient and unique visual elements such as the subjects, their clothing, expressions, actions, background, and composition. Describe the color palette, lighting, and overall style, including any cinematic or artistic qualities like camera angle, depth of field, or motion. Make the description as accurate and faithful to the image as possible. If small details are uncertain or ambiguous, omit them and prioritize capturing the overall scene, mood, and visual impression. The final prompt should be coherent, evocative, written as if by an expert visual artist or filmmaker recreating the exact scene.
caption: A close-up, high-resolution image of a cheeseburger being assembled on a clean, white surface. The focus is on a pair of well-manicured hands with bright pink nail polish, gently placing a slice of yellow American cheese on top of a thick, juicy beef patty. Another slice of cheese is already melted beneath the patty, resting on the bottom half of a soft, lightly toasted hamburger bun. The background is softly blurred, featuring a neutral, creamy white tone that keeps all attention on the burger and hands. The lighting is bright and even, highlighting the textures of the beef, the smoothness of the cheese, and the subtle sheen on the bun. The composition is centered and symmetrical, with a shallow depth of field that creates a crisp, appetizing focus on the food and hands, evoking a clean, modern, and inviting culinary atmosphere.
